segments.title: Playing clarinet and drums on the road; leaving for Las Vegas
segments.summary: Johnson says he played clarinet and drums on the road, drums on the Pantages circuit. He left at about nineteen because his sister sent for him to help in her Las Vegas saloon, where he played piano day and night.

segments.title: Asked to play Jelly Roll Morton tunes
segments.summary: The interviewer asks whether he can play any of Jelly's tunes such as Milenberg Joys and Wolverine; the rest is garbled talk.

segments.title: Asked about pianists, then 'Dirty Baby' song
segments.summary: The interviewer asks about several musicians and he says no; he then sings the 'Dirty Baby' lyric, followed by filler.
